mapSelect.title: Select Map
mapSelect.subtitle: Pick a battlefield to start; you can choose another map after the battle.

default.name: Twin Islands
default.description: A shipyard island on each side with a wide central channel; ideal for learning the controls and head-on fights.

strait.name: Central Strait
strait.description: Northern and southern island chains squeeze the fleet into a narrow central channel with little room to flank.

archipelago.name: Archipelago Shoals
archipelago.description: Scattered islands and reefs split the sea into winding channels that reward detours and terrain use.

hud.title: 2D Naval Battle · Auto Battle
hud.weaponInfo: Main Gun 10 DMG (arc · range 1100) · Torpedo 30 DMG ×3-5 · Dodge Turn 90°
hud.selectionHint: Click to select · Shift multi-select · Right-click to move · F attacks nearest enemy (2.5s cooldown)
hud.restartPrompt: Return to map selection and start a new battle?

playground.allow2x: Whether to show the 2x speed button

ship.title: Ship Debug
ship.hint: Click a ship to select it (hold Shift for multi-select), right-click to let the selection sail there, press F to attack.

weapons.title: Weapon Debug
weapons.hint: Click the canvas to fire at that point; direction and distance vary randomly.
